As a Entry-Level Technician (Career Switcher) at Blok System Supply, you are responsible for all work on electrical installations and panels, such as control cabinets and access gates. You assemble mechanical components and integrate electrical and mechanical parts. You perform assembly work according to technical drawings or work instructions and build products either as complete systems or as submodules. 
You also test each product and (semi-finished) assembly according to customer-specific requirements, which ensures a high level of variety in your work. Together with your colleagues, you perform final and intermediate inspections in accordance with the customer-specific final test procedures. In addition, you also carry out in-process checks on your colleagues' work.
